name: Sundrek Tamarind-Pomegranate Burn
description: An aggressively sour synth-flavored soda combining tamarind tartness with deep pomegranate and a chili-salt rim powder sold separately in a sachet attached to the bottle neck.
flavor_profile: Face-puckering tamarind sourness, dark pomegranate depth, and optional chili-salt that transforms the drink into something closer to a savory experience.
slogan: Make your face do the thing.
cultural_context: Sundrek's rim powder sachet gimmick became a minor trend on the Shelf, with people experimenting with their own chili blends and posting the results on local mesh networks. The brand leans into the DIY culture rather than fighting it.
story_hooks: Someone has started selling a counterfeit Sundrek rim powder that contains a low-grade stimulant — the effect is mild but it's technically illegal and Sundrek is taking the liability heat.
A Shelf food festival organized around Sundrek customization has become politically significant — it's drawing Tier 3 journalists and the community is divided about the exposure.
A character trying to go unnoticed on the Shelf is identified by a contact who recognizes the specific way they prepare their Sundrek — a personal habit from years ago.
